note: Reported points and front times from research/events.md; not model output.

points.name: Collapse source
points.text: Approximate source of the ice-rock avalanche (CLaSH, from Planet images of 25 and 28 Aug). The USGS catalogue places the signal 2.8 km to the south-west.

points.name: Impact depression and its lake
points.text: The mass fell about 1,000 to 1,400 m into this depression and ran about 450 m up the opposite slope. A lake about 530 m long then formed here; it drained through the ground on 31 Aug.

points.name: Second landslide, 11:45
points.text: Second landslide signal at 11:45:35 (USGS M4.2, SOLID). It dammed the Lhende Khola at the Chhochen confluence at about 2,800 m (LIKELY).

points.name: Landslide-dam lake, Chhochen confluence
points.text: A lake of about 0.11 km2 formed behind the second landslide; it overflowed and drained on 28 Aug.

points.name: Border at Rasuwagadhi: station 446.22, flow height
points.text: Station destroyed; its level fell slowly from the afternoon of 25 Aug until it stopped, which may show an upstream blockage or a normal recession (station location approximate). Trimlines put the flow 40 to 134 m above the river here (Geopera); observers at Timure reported a flood 200 to 300 m high (relayed).

points.name: Flow height in the gorges
points.text: Median flow height about 70 m in the gorges above Syabrubesi (Geopera trimlines); valley walls scoured 100 to 200 m up (Zhao et al.).

points.name: Syabrubesi station (446.25)
points.text: Destroyed; stopped at 08:50 according to NDRRMA and the RDNA (ICIMOD gives 08:50 for Rasuwagadhi). Location approximate.

points.name: Betrawati (Phalakhu) station (446.8)
points.text: Stopped transmitting at 09:20; last level 3.55 m, below warning (4.1 m). Location approximate.

points.name: Galchhi station
points.text: Stayed in operation: +8.5 m at 10:50 (CLaSH); about 8.9 m maximum stage (ICIMOD).

points.name: Phurke station near Malekhu
points.text: Above warning 11:26, above danger 11:43, then lost with its bridge. Location approximate (Malekhu).

points.name: Devghat station (450)
points.text: Narayani below the Kali Gandaki: peak 6.57 m at 16:00, about 5,850 m3/s. Location from the DHM station page, rounded to 0.01 deg.

front.note: Envelope of reported front times above Syabrubesi, minutes after 08:00, for a front that moves downstream; bounded in practice by the Gyirong and Syabrubesi reports, so some reports (Timure 09:10-09:25, Rasuwagadhi 09:00-09:05) fall outside it.

reports.text: Debris at Gyirong port about 7 min after the collapse (CCTV)
